hypothesis: V8's approximately one-second TCN receptive field may miss full 10-20 second activity dynamics. Expanding only the temporal dilation schedule to an approximately 25.7-second theoretical receptive field should improve subject-level discrimination if long-range dynamics are limiting.
folds: fixed 5 outer contexts x 3 inner validation folds
stop_rule: Retain only after seeds 42/43/44 if mean BA improves by at least 0.01, at least 9 of 15 seed-averaged matched folds improve, and AUROC/Macro-F1 do not materially regress. Outer-test data are prohibited.
